**Describe the bug** Running the `compute-sanitizer` tool on code invoking the parquet reader fails, this led me to try the `PARQUET_TESTS` unit tests which fail very early. This blocks me from using the tool in any code that reads parquet files. **Steps/Code to reproduce bug** Build `libcudf` with tests, and run the `PARQUET_TESTS` with the `compute-sanitizer` tool from the build tree: ``` compute-sanitizer ./gtests/PARQUET_TEST ========= COMPUTE-SANITIZER [==========] Running 339 tests from 94 test suites. [----------] Global test environment set-up. [----------] 12 tests from ParquetChunkedReaderTest [ RUN ] ParquetChunkedReaderTest.TestChunkedReadNoData [ OK ] ParquetChunkedReaderTest.TestChunkedReadNoData (314 ms) [ RUN ] ParquetChunkedReaderTest.TestChunkedReadSimpleData ========= Invalid __shared__ read of size 0 bytes ========= at void cudf::io::parquet::detail::::gpuDecodePageDataFixed(cudf::io::parquet::detail::PageInfo *, cudf::device_span, unsigned long, unsigned long, unsigned int *)+0x9110 ========= by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0) ========= Address 0x348 is misaligned ========= Saved host backtrace up to driver entry point at kernel launch time ========= Host Frame: [0x2f16d0] ========= in /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 ========= Host Frame: [0x156e4] ========= in /usr/local/cuda-12.3/targets/x86_64-linux/lib/libcudart.so.12 ========= Host Frame:cudaLaunchKernel [0x74631] ========= in /usr/local/cuda-12.3/targets/x86_64-linux/lib/libcudart.so.12 ========= Host Frame:cudf::io::parquet::detail::DecodePageDataFixed(cudf::detail::hostdevice_span, cudf::detail::hostdevice_span, unsigned long, unsigned long, int, unsigned int*, rmm::cuda_stream_view) [0x1529ec7] ========= in /home/marcus/src/cudf/cpp/gcc11/libcudf.so ========= Host Frame:cudf::io::parquet::detail::reader::impl::decode_page_data(cudf::io::parquet::detail::reader::impl::read_mode, unsigned long, unsigned long) [0x14a9075] ========= in /home/marcus/src/cudf/cpp/gcc11/libcudf.so ========= Host Frame:cudf::io::parquet::detail::reader::impl::read_chunk_internal(cudf::io::parquet::detail::reader::impl::read_mode) [0x14aaef0] ========= in /home/marcus/src/cudf/cpp/gcc11/libcudf.so ========= Host Frame:cudf::io::parquet::detail::reader::impl::read_chunk() [0x14ab67f] ========= in /home/marcus/src/cudf/cpp/gcc11/libcudf.so ========= Host Frame:cudf::io::parquet::detail::chunked_reader::read_chunk() const [0x149e9c6] ========= in /home/marcus/src/cudf/cpp/gcc11/libcudf.so ========= Host Frame:cudf::io::chunked_parquet_reader::read_chunk() const [0x13584cc] ========= in /home/marcus/src/cudf/cpp/gcc11/libcudf.so ========= Host Frame:(anonymous namespace)::chunked_read(std::vector, std::allocator >, std::allocator, std::allocator > > > const&, unsigned long, unsigned long) [0x105b63] ``` **Expected behavior** For the `compute-sanitizer` to run with the tests passing. **Environment overview (please complete the following information)** - Environment location: Bare-metal - Method of cuDF install: from source **Environment details** Please run and paste the output of the `cudf/print_env.sh` script here, to gather any other relevant environment details
